legend: Mukhtar is obsessed with octopuses and the deep sea.
At the Dead Sea, floating salt formations act as platforms connected by unusual water currents caused by natural conditions. Mukhtar uses these platforms to move around.
The platforms are represented as nodes of an undirected graph. If there is an edge between two platforms, then Mukhtar can directly move between them.
Unfortunately, some platforms are overcrowded with Salt creatures, so Mukhtar cannot stand on them.

Mukhtar has a special ability if an overcrowded platform v$$$v$$$ lies between two platforms u$$$u$$$ and w$$$w$$$ such that there is an edge (u,v)$$$(u, v)$$$ and an edge (v,w)$$$(v, w)$$$, then he may skip platform v$$$v$$$ and move directly from u$$$u$$$ to w$$$w$$$ without standing on v$$$v$$$. Using this ability on platform v$$$v$$$ costs f(v)$$$f(v)$$$.
Mukhtar starts at platform 1$$$1$$$ and wants to reach platform n$$$n$$$.
However, his energy is limited. If the total cost of skipped platforms used in his path exceeds c$$$c$$$, Mukhtar gets trapped and cannot escape until the conditions improve.
If there is no valid route from platform 1$$$1$$$ to platform n$$$n$$$, or if the minimum possible total cost is greater than c$$$c$$$, print −1$$$-1$$$. Otherwise, print the minimum total cost.
input: The first line contains four integers n$$$n$$$, m$$$m$$$, k$$$k$$$, and c$$$c$$$ (2≤n,m≤2⋅105$$$2 \le n, m \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$, 0≤k≤n−2$$$0 \le k \le n-2$$$, 0≤c≤1018$$$0 \le c \le 10^{18}$$$) — the number of platforms, the number of edges, the number of crowded platforms, and the maximum total skip cost Mukhtar can afford respectively.
The second line contains k$$$k$$$ distinct integers — the indices of the crowded platforms.
The third line contains n$$$n$$$ integers f(1),f(2),…,f(n)$$$f(1), f(2), \ldots, f(n)$$$ (0≤f(i)≤109$$$0 \le f(i) \le 10^9$$$), where f(i)$$$f(i)$$$ is the cost of skipping platform i$$$i$$$.
Each of the next m$$$m$$$ lines contains two integers u$$$u$$$ and v$$$v$$$ (1≤u,v≤n$$$1 \le u, v \le n$$$, u≠v$$$u \ne v$$$), denoting an undirected edge between platforms u$$$u$$$ and v$$$v$$$.
It is guaranteed that platforms 1$$$1$$$ and n$$$n$$$ are not crowded.
output: Print the minimum possible total skip cost or −1$$$-1$$$ if its Impossible.
note: The crowded platforms are 3$$$3$$$ and 5$$$5$$$, with skip costs f(3)=8$$$f(3) = 8$$$ and f(5)=2$$$f(5) = 2$$$.
Mukhtar can use the allowed operation to skip platform 5$$$5$$$ while traversing a valid path, resulting in a total cost of 2$$$2$$$.

legend.ai: Mukhtar 对章鱼和深海着迷。
在死海，漂浮的盐层充当平台，它们由自然条件造成的异常水流连接起来。Mukhtar 利用这些平台四处移动。
这些平台被表示为无向图中的节点。如果两个平台之间存在一条边，那么 Mukhtar 就可以在它们之间直接移动。
不幸的是，一些平台上挤满了盐生物，因此 Mukhtar 无法站在上面。

如果一座拥挤的平台 v$$$v$$$ 位于两个平台 u$$$u$$$ 和 w$$$w$$$ 之间，且存在一条边 (u,v)$$$(u, v)$$$ 和一条边 (v,w)$$$(v, w)$$$，那么 Mukhtar 可以跳过平台 v$$$v$$$，从 u$$$u$$$ 直接移动到 w$$$w$$$，而无需停留在 v$$$v$$$ 上。在平台 v$$$v$$$ 上使用此能力的代价为 f(v)$$$f(v)$$$。
Mukhtar 从平台 1$$$1$$$ 出发，想要到达平台 n$$$n$$$。
然而，他的能量有限。如果其路径中跳过的平台的总代价超过 c$$$c$$$，Mukhtar 就会被困住，直到条件改善后才能逃脱。
判断 Mukhtar 是否能够逃脱。
如果不存在从平台 1$$$1$$$ 到平台 n$$$n$$$ 的有效路线，或可能的最小总代价大于 c$$$c$$$，输出 −1$$$-1$$$。否则，输出最小总代价。

input.ai: 第一行包含四个整数 n$$$n$$$、m$$$m$$$、k$$$k$$$ 和 c$$$c$$$(2≤n,m≤2⋅105$$$2 \le n, m \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$，0≤k≤n−2$$$0 \le k \le n-2$$$，0≤c≤1018$$$0 \le c \le 10^{18}$$$)——分别表示平台数量、边的数量、拥挤平台的数量，以及 Mukhtar 能够承担的最大跳过总代价。
第二行包含 k$$$k$$$ 个互不相同的整数——拥挤平台的编号。
接下来的 m$$$m$$$ 行中的每一行包含两个整数 u$$$u$$$ 和 v$$$v$$$ (1≤u,v≤n$$$1 \le u, v \le n$$$，u≠v$$$u \ne v$$$)，表示平台 u$$$u$$$ 和 v$$$v$$$ 之间的一条无向边。
保证平台 1$$$1$$$ 和 n$$$n$$$ 不拥挤。

output.ai: 输出可能的最小总跳过代价；如果无法做到，则输出 −1$$$-1$$$。

note.ai: 第一个测试用例的解释：
Mukhtar 可以在经过一条合法路径时使用允许的操作跳过平台 5$$$5$$$，从而使总费用为 2$$$2$$$。
